title: C++ Random Numbers
description: A second quiz file to demonstrate Phase 2 content swapping.

questions.question: What does std::random_device usually provide?
questions.explanation: std::random_device is commonly used as an entropy source for seeding pseudo-random generators.

questions.question: std::mt19937 is a random distribution.
questions.explanation: std::mt19937 is a pseudo-random number engine. A distribution maps engine output into useful ranges.

questions.question: Which line creates an integer distribution from 1 through 6?
questions.explanation: uniform_int_distribution<int> models integer results across the inclusive range.
